body:
The issue of Sync is broken and plays from the beginning does indeed exist, and that will be fixed in https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/100373.

However, as a problem specific to your MRP, **the transition `walk -> idle` occurs during the change of direction**, so the issue remains because the Transition is set to Reset.

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/60ea0ee7-7377-45b1-b624-94a754e1a87f)

I'm also concerned about mismatching CallbackModeProcess due to _physics_process() vs Idle.

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/bd4a9320-1fc2-4ec9-b43c-09f3f210b234)

So, even if applying https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/100373, you should consider rethinking the Transition advance condition or disabling the Reset option.
